title: The Ninth Chamber
help: WASD / arrows move · Space jump · E action · Shift walk · F or right click fire · R draw / holster · Tab next target · H medkit · drag the mouse to look · C recenter
error.noWebGL: Your browser supports neither WebGPU nor WebGL2. Try a recent version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
hint.grab: Jump towards a ledge to grab it. Push forward to climb up.
hint.push: Hold Action against a block, then push or pull.
hint.runningJump: Run for a moment before jumping to cross wide gaps.
hint.plate: Bronze plates hold their gates open only while something weighs on them.
hint.weight: The gate will not wait for you. Something heavy could keep the plate down.
hint.timer: Hear the ticking? This gate lingers a few seconds after you step off. Run.
hint.standingJump: From a standstill, a jump clears a one-block gap.
hint.fill: A block pushed into a gap drops in and becomes floor.
hint.scales: Two plates, one gate: both must bear weight at the same time.
hint.reset: If the blocks end up where they cannot help, the spring lever by the entrance puts them back.
hint.dropHang: Hold Walk and Action and step back off an edge to lower yourself and hang. Letting go from there is a shorter fall.
notice.died: Nora fell. Returning to the last checkpoint…
end.title: Chamber cleared
